tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ rnam rtog don dam gyi ngo sprod bzhugs//

༄༅// na mo gu ru rat+na bh+yaḥ rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/ yar sangs rgyas la re ba med de/ sku gsung thugs rang la yod pa'i phyir ro// mar 'khor ba la dogs pa med cing spang du med de/ shes rab kyi bud shing yin pa'i phyir ro// dge bshes lcags ri ba'i bla ma rnam gnyis kyi gdams ngag yin te/ sgom chen de bsgom pa'i dus su/ rnam par rtog pa 'byung ste/ phrad 'joms pa/ phyi bsnyags/ med sprul pa rnam pa gsum mo// dang po rnam rtog byung ma thag skye med du chod pa ni/ phrad 'joms pa bya ba yin/ phrad ma thag ma choms na/ phyi bsnyag gsung*/ rnam rtog de gang nas byung*/ de sems las byung*/ sems su thim/ sems dang gnyis tha mi dad de/ phyi bsnyag bya ba yin gsung*/ med sprul pa ni/ gang shes pa la lci ba/ nyams la mi bde ba cig med sprul pa yin te/ 'o skol rab tu byung ba la rtsa bzhi shes dgos pa lci ste/ de nyid med sprul te/ (2na)de rnam par rtog pa yin/ rnam rtog de sems yin/ sems skye med yin gsung*/ dper na/ nags la me shor na/ me chung ngu rlung gis 'chi ba yin/ nags tshal chen po tshig tsam na/ rlung yang grogs su 'gro / shing mang po yang dag pa tshogs nas me la dmag 'dren pa la/ me na re/ da rung khyed rang mang du spungs dang*/ khyod ji ltar mang ba bzhin/ bdag dga' ba yin zer la/ de bzhin du rnam rtog mang ba bzhin/ shes rab kyi grogs su 'gro gsung ngo*// sa rdo tshun chad grogs su 'gro/ de bzhin du/ rnam rtog ji ltar mang ba bzhin shes rab kyi grogs su 'gro gsung*/ mtsho la kha ba bab pa dang 'dra ste/ babs ma thag tu ro gcig tu 'gyur ro// de bzhin du rnam rtog byung ma thag tu lhan cig skyes par ro gcig /sngar 'dris pa'i mi phrad phrad pa dang 'dra ste/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad tsa na/ yin min rtog dpyod bya mi dgos/ de bzhin du/ rnam rtog la rtog dpyod bya mi dgos par skye med du ngo shes gsung*/

de ni dge bshes lcags ri ba'i yin/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ rnam par rtog pa de ni/ dgos pa/ sku drin (2ba)can/ med du mi rung ba/ yon tan thams cad kho rang la rang chas su yod pa yin gsung*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam gtan bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas/ 'od gsal gyi rtsal sbyang ba yin gsung*/ gsang sngags kyi dbang du byas na/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la log nas kyang*/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten nas rtsal sbyang ba yin gsung*/ sgom chen pa rnam rtog skyon du mi lta bar/ rtogs pa la dbang thob pa cig dgos gsung*/ 'o na rtogs pa la dbang thob pa'i sgom chen pa de la na ba 'ong ngam zhe na/ 'ong ste/ byung ma thag tu na ba rnam par rtog pa yin/ rnam par rtog pa sems yin/ sems de ltar skye med du rtogs pa cig mchi/ de la 'chi ba 'ong ste/ skye ba med pa'i gnad kas 'chi ba yang skye med du shes/ gal te dmyal ba'i snang ba lta bu shar yang*/ 'di rnam par rtog pa yin/ rnam par rtog pa sems yin/ sems skye ba med pa yin snyam pa 'ong ste/ dar gyi pho long brdab pa tsam gsung*/ sems kyi ngo bo la res 'ga' tha mal gyi shes pa bya bar ming btags te/ de thams cad gcig yin gsung*/ res 'ga' gnyug ma bya bar ming btags te/ de chos nyid gcig yin gsung*/ don la ngo bo bya ba yin te/ med pa ma yin pa'i don te/ sangs rgyas la gsal gsung*/ gaṅgās rnal 'byor pa la rang shugs kyis 'byung gsung*/ bsgrims pas 'ong du re ste/ bsgrims pas mi mchi/ glod pas mi mchi/ 'o na ji ltar byas na mchi/ rnal 'byor ma gaṅgā dha ras gsung pa de yin/ de'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas nas/ rnal 'byor pa gcig gis bsgoms pas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa byung*/ lus ras bal gyi 'dab ma bzhin du (3na)yang ba byung*/ snang ba 'od kyi gong bu ltar mthong nas/ bla ma la 'di ltar byung zhes brjod pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/

thos bsam byas pa de thams cad kyis dang po'i shes pa de rang tshol ba yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ khos ma go nas log nas phyin pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma gaṅgā dha ra'i zhal nas/ gar phyin gsungs pas/ ngas bla ma'i drung du phyin pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu/ yul la ma blta sems la ma ltos shig /bya ba ma mang zhe 'dod ma byed cig /nyam nga ma byed dogs pa ma 'cha' bar// sems ni gang dga' nyid du thong la thong*// zhes gsungs pas/ rnal 'byor pa des kyang grub pa thob gsung*/ rnal 'byor ma kar ka do ha'i zhal nas/ gnyis med shes pa chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa 'dra// nyams myong spre'u lta bur gang ltar 'gyur kyang rung*// rnal ma'i shes pa glang po lta bu la// rtog pa nam mkha' bzhin du ji bzhin khyab// ces gsungs so// dge bshes lcags ri ba la/ bla ma nyid kyis/ bka' gdams mi spong bar lam du 'khyer ba'i gdams ngag yod dam zhus pa la/ lcags ri ba'i zhal nas/ dge bshes glang ri thang pas/ dge bshes phu chung pa la zhus pas/ tshems nem mdzad nas/ yod dag yod de/ nga la zlos dbang med pa gsung skad/ phyis rnal 'byor pa rnam gnyis la gdams ngag tu byung gsung*/ lo ts+tsha ba rin chen bzang po dang*/ sgom chen pa puṇ+ye dzñā bo dhi gnyis kyi sras lags skad/ dbus su lcags ri ba smin par mdzad/ gdams ngag ji ltar byung zhe na/ chos tshan pa dgu yod gsung*/ rtogs pa'i rgyu med cing gzhi rtsa ma grub pas/ rtogs pa'i (3ba)thabs la mkhas te/ bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya'i dpe gsung*/ dge bshes phu chung pa'i zhal nas/ rtog pa lam du khyer nas spang na ci la 'ong gsung skad/ de yang bla ma dang cung mi 'dra/ stong nyid ra mdar ldog /gzhug en tsam yod gsung*/ rtog pa rgyu med pa dang*/ shes rab kyi bud shing yin pa dang*/ de la sogs pa rgyas par gsung*/ bla ma ni snying nas rtog pa la sku drin che bar bshad pa yin gsung*/ dgos pa/ sku drin che ba ji ltar yin na/

de sems las byung ba yin/ sems chos kyi sku yin/ rtog pa de/ ngo bo nyid kyi rtogs pa yin/ rtogs pa des/ ngo bo gsal bar byed pas na sgron me lta bu yin/ rtsa ba rnyed par byed pas na mtshon lta bu yin/ rtog pa lam du khyer bas/ rtog med 'char gsung ngo*// rtog pa de rgyu yin nam/ lam yin nam/ 'bras bu yin nam gang yin byas pas/ rgyu yin te/ kho rang la brten nas yon tan thams cad 'byung*/ lam yang yin te/ mi spong bar lam du byed gsung*/ 'bras bu yang yin te/ ngo bo nyid kyi rtogs pa yin pas/ sku bzhi rang chas su yod gsung*/ 'bras bu la mi re ste/ rgyu lam 'bras gsum du 'byongs pa bya ba yin gsung ngo*// ༈ // chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi zhal gdams bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ yi dam lha'i bskyed rim rdzogs par yang skad cig ma re sgom dgos gsung*/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis yi dam gyi lhar bskyed nas/ 'od gsal 'ba' zhig sgom pa yin no gsung*/ de yang*/ gsal sing nge ba de nyams myong yin/ de la ma yengs pa de gnas pa yin/ shes (4na)rab kyis bltas pas/ ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa de rtogs pa yin gsung*/ bla ma rtogs ldan cig dang*/ slob ma skal ldan tshe 'di blos btang ba cig phrad nas/ bla ma des/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang bzhi bskur nas/ smin pa grol bar byed pa'i thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis la slob pa yin gsung*/ bskyed rim ni/ lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bur bsgom pa dang*/ spros pa dang bcas pa'i rdzogs rim kyang de yin gsung*/ rdzogs rim ni 'od gsal sems kyi stong nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa de lags/ de ltar bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pas yon tan 'byung ste/ de yang dben par bsgoms pa las 'byung gsung*/ lus bde ba dang*/ sems bde ba 'ong ste/ nang du rtags rnam lnga 'char/

phyir yang phan yon brgyad 'byung ste/ rtags dang phan yon du ba lta bu byung tsa na/ rlung snang ba 'gags te/ rlung a wa dhū tir tshud pa yin gsung*/ rtags gnyis pa shar tsa na/ snang ba nyams su myong ba bya ba yin/ rtags gsum pa byung tsa na/ gsal la mi rtog pa 'byung*/ de ni sgom pa'i mthar thug yin te/ rlung sems su tshud pa yin gsung*/ rtags bzhi pa shar tsa na/ lta ba'i don dang*/ chos thams cad ro gcig rig cing gsal ba dang*/ 'phrin las bzhi 'grub ste/ lta ba'i don bya ba ni/ sems nyid la blo nges pa'o// chos thams cad ro gcig rig cing gsal ba ni/ 'khor 'das thams cad 'od gsal du 'char ba'o// 'phrin las bzhi ni/ bzlas pa la sogs pa bya ma dgos par/ 'phrin las bzhi gang byas kyang tshegs med du 'grub pa'o// rlung 'od gsal du tshud pa'i dus su/ ye shes kyi rtags kyang 'byung ste/ lus 'ja' tshon nam (4ba)'od kyi gong bu lta bu la sogs pa yang 'byung ngo*// de ye shes kyi rtags bya ba yin gsung*/ blta bya lta byed med pa la stong pa nyid zer ba yin/ khams gsum las 'das shing blo dang bral ba la smon pa med pa zer ba yin gsung*/ sgrub pa la bdud kyi bar chad 'byung ba'i bdud la gnyis te/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bdud dang*/ rnam par rtog pa'i bdud do// de la sel thabs rnam pa gsum yod/ byams snying rje bsgoms pas sel ba yin te/ byams snying rje bsgoms pas/ mas bu la gnod pa byed mi srid/ sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu dang*/ stong nyid bsgoms pas sel te/ gnod bya gnod byed gnyis med gsung*/ 'khrul par shes pas zhi/ de thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul du shes pas/ gnod pa mi byed/ byas kyang mi tshugs/ da lta 'khor mang ba dang*/ rdzas kyi bsod nams 'byung ba 'di/ gsang sngags nas thun mong gi dngos grub tu yang bshad de/ bdud kyi bar chad yin yang gsung*/ bdud kyis kyang dngos su bar du mi gcod/

sngon la 'khor gyis bar du gcod/ de nas/ rdzas kyi bsod nams chen pos dge sbyor la bar du gcod/ de nas sgrub pa po de chags sdang gis bar du chod nas 'gro ba yin gsung*/ bdud kyi bar chad yin min rang gi sems la blta gsung*/ rang la gnod na bdud kyi bar chad yin/ mi gnod na dngos grub yin no gsung ngo*// so ma la gsum/ de lus khong glod pa/ ngag rlung mi btsir bar rang dgar bzhag pa/ shes pa rten mi bca' ba'o// rang dga' la gsum/ shes pa rang dgar gtad/ 'phros pa'i yul mtshan mar snang ba de chos skur shes par bya ba/ de la ma yengs pa'o// lhug pa la gsum/ spyod lam rnam bzhi (5na)la khyad par med par bya ba/ nyams dang mi 'bral bar bya ba/ tshogs drug lhug par bzhag pa'o// gsang sngags kyi dbang du byas na yang*/ bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyis/ dang po nas rdzogs par mi ston/ dang po tshogs gsog tsam zhig ston/ de nas bskyed rim tsam zhig ston/ de nas dbang bskur ba/ de nas bdud rtsi myong ba/ de nas mchod bstod/ de nas rdzogs rim ston pa yin te/ de nas rim gyis ston/ dge bshes lcags ri ba'i zhal nas/ lta ba kun rdzob yin gsung*/ mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i sgyu ma bya ba de/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lta ba yin/ don dam pa la lta rgyu med gsung*/ gsang sngags kyi lta ba sems yin gsung*/ nā ro pa'i bzhed pas/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa la dbang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa la bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ de stan thog gcig tu bsgom par bya ba dang*/ rim gyis pa'i lugs gnyis yin te/ stan thog gcig tu bsgom pa ni/ dus gcig tu sgom la/ rim gyis pa ni/ bskyed rim la brten pa thob nas/ rdzogs rim bsgom/ de yang*/ nang nas shar ba de rdzogs rim rnal ma de yin/ nang nas ma shar na/ zab pa'i rdzogs rim du ming btags kyang*/ blos byas cig yin gsung*/ spyir de ltar yin kyang*/ 'khor ba mtha' dag las thar pa la don dam pa byang chub kyi sems dgos te/

de yang jo bo rje'i lugs kyis/ gcig dang du bral la sogs pas phyi nas gcod pa yin/ bla ma'i bzhed pas/ nang nas gcod pa yin gsung*/ kha cig nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa nas/ mas nas yar spong bar 'dod pa yin/ bla ma ni shes (5ba)bya'i sgrib pa nas rtsad der gcod/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku/ lhan cig ci ltar skyes na/ bla ma'i bzhed pas/ rig pa dang stong pa lhan cig skyes gsung*/ grub pa thob pa'i grub skor nas bshad pa dang*/ bram ze chen po'i do ha nas bshad pa dang*/ rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud nas bshad pa dang*/ de rnams yo mthun gsung*/ bla ma'i zhal nas min na rang nor gsung*/ tshan cig nas/ thabs gtso cher bshad de blo dman pa'i dus su thabs gtso che ba man ngag yin gsung*/ blo yar song tsa na shes rab gtso che ba yin gsung*/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ shes rab gtso cher rang shugs kyis 'gro ba yin gsung*/ dang po yo mi dgos snyam tsa na dgos bdo ba yin gsung*/ shugs 'byung gis 'gags pa cig dgos/ shugs 'byung bya ba'i go ba ni/ blo bcos ma dang bral ba cig la zer ba yin gsung*/ sgom chen pa rnams la zhu na/ gnas pa'i dus su/ rtog med de rgyun bsring ba yin te/ ngo bo la rtog med rgyun bsring na/ chos kyi gnad ma go ba yin/ chos ma chod pa yin gsung*/ gdod ma nas rgyun chad ma myong ba'i gnad kas gsung*/ don dam pa 'di 'dra ba cig yin bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang smra bar ma nus na/ rgyun chad med pa de sangs rgyas byon yang mi khegs gsung*/ dge bshes yon bdag gi zhal nas/ grub mtha' la brten nas rigs pas gzhigs pas/ sha ba sgye 'ur chud pa ltar/ 'gro sa 'di las med zer te/ khyed rnams kyi blo phugs rdar 'byams pa de ni khyod rang gis byas pa yin na/ a na/ ang ge /khyed kyi de 'ong bar 'ong*/ phung 'dre mkhan logs na lus pa cha med pa gsung*/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ bka' gdams pa yang*/

lta ba la (6na)rtsis che ste/ grub mtha'i lta ba 'di ltar lags zer ba la rtsis mi che/ lta ba lta bas stong pa la rtsis che gsung*/ bla ma yang lta ba 'di ltar lags zer ba la rtsis mi che/ lta ba rang shar la rtsis su mdzad/ chos thams cad nyams thog nas smra ba gcig dgos gsung*/ stong nyid shes bya'i gshis sgom pa dang*/ rtsa rlung bsgoms pa'i rten 'brel gyis nyams byung ba de yang*/ nyams yin te/ sha chod rus chod mi mchis gsung*/ chos sha rus chod pa la/ don dam skye ba'i nyams shig skye dgos gsung*/ kun rdzob sgyu mar mthong ba bya ba dang*/ sems nyid sgyu mar mthong na/ de nyid yid la bgyi ba yang mi 'tshal/ med pa yang ma yin te/ bkag pas mi khegs gsung*/ blo'i yul du byar mi rung*/ grub thob kyi bla mas gsung pa dang*/ sangs rgyas gsung ba yo mthun/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs la gsal ba de dang*/ rnal 'byor pa la bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis rang shugs su byung ba de yod pa ma yin te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na/ rnam rtog gi blos mthong ba lta ci smos/ med pa ma yin te/ gang tshe don la reg gyur na// bsam pa kun gyis bsam du med// gang tshe bsam du med sems pa// de tshe bsam mi khyab par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so/// /dge bshes po to ba'i zhal nas/ ka pā li dang bral na med pa yin gsung*/ dge bshes phu chung ba'i zhal nas/ res sgom res blta byed pa yin gsung*/ dge bshes spyan snga ba'i zhal nas/ dpe lta sgom chen po bya ba de mi 'dod pa yin gsung*/ bzod phugs dgos pa yin gsung skad// ༈ //

chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ lam rim mdor bsdus bzhugs so// (6ba)bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rje'i zhal nas/ 'o skol rnams kyi gtan yul ngan song gsum yin/ da res dal 'byor lus thob pa 'di ngan song gi sa nas don gnyer ba'am/ ngal bso ba lta bu yin/ 'gron po'i tshod tsam yin/ de nas yang ngan song du 'gro ba yin/ 'o skol 'chi tsa na yang*/ rang gi pha yul ngan song gsum yin/ der 'gro zer nas 'gro ba yin/ de'i nang nas kyang dmyal bar 'gro ba yin/ 'o na/ ngan song gsum na bde skyid yod dam snyam na/ bde skyid med pas/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal yid la byas la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la 'jigs skrag par byas la/ da ni ngan song gsum du cis kyang mi skye ba zhig byed dgos snyam du yang yang bsam/ de ltar ngan song gis 'jigs tsa na/ skyabs 'tshol dgos pas/ skyabs ni bla ma la bya ste/ gsol ba gdab/ jo bo dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro bya/ gsol ba gdab/ ngan song du skye ba'i rgyu sdig pa mi dge ba bcu yin pas/ sdig pa phra mo tsam yang mi bya bar/ sdig pa'i las 'bras la yid ches par bya/ mtho ris su skye bar byed pa'i rgyu/ dge ba yin pas/ dge ba phra zhing phra ba nas bsgrub/ dge ba'i las 'bras la yid ches par bya/ des bsnyen gnas dang*/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa skye/ tshe 'di la blo log par bya/ de ltar byas na/ ngan song du phul yang mi 'gro ste/ de ni skyes bu chung ngu'i lam yin no// des kyang cung mi 'ong ste/ lha mi gnyis rang la bde skyid med de/ sdug bsngal las ma 'das/ des na/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom/ thams cad mi rtag pa yin pas/ mi rtag pa bsgom/ tshe 'di'i nye du (7na)dang*/ rdzas dang*/ rang gi lus la yang ma chags pa bsgom/ de ltar byas na/ nyan thos kyi byang chub thob ste/ nyan thos kyi lam yin no// de ni skyes bu 'bring gi lam yin te rang don 'ba' zhig go

/des kyang cung mi 'ong ste/ 'khor ba na yod pa'i sems can rnams kyis nged rang gi pha ma ma byas pa med pas/ de rnams la byams snying rje bsgoms la/ bdag pas gzhan gces par bzung*/ theg dman las blo log par bya zhing*/ de la brtan pa dang*/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bskyed/ smon 'jug gnyis blangs la/ de'i bslab bya slob pa de ni skyes bu mchog gi lam yin no// des kyang 'khor ba las 'don par mi nus pas/ don dam byang chub kyi sems skye med sgom dgos/ de bsgoms pas dngos po dang mtshan ma las blo ldog /de ltar bsgoms pas nyams myong bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum 'byung ste/ de la yang zhen na mi 'ong*/ bde ba shas che na/ de la zhen pas 'dod khams/ gsal ba shas che na/ de la zhen pas gzugs khams/ mi rtog pa shas che na/ de la zhen pas gzugs med khams su skye ba'i rgyu yin no// 'o na ji ltar du rang gi sems nyid gnyug ma 'di nyid bsgom na/ de yang*/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// mar la mar ni bzhag pa bzhin// ma bcos par bzhag /so ma/ lhug pa/ rang ga gsum du bzhag pas/ cung zad sems zin pa 'ong*/ sems kyi ngo bo bag re tsam mthong ba 'ong*/ shes pa sing nge yer re rtse gcig pa 'ong*/ rjes la yang bag re 'ong*/ de tsa na rang gi rig pa dum tsam zhig ngo shes pas/ nyams dga' ba dang*/ spro ba 'ong ste/ (7ba)de ni rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bya ba yin/ de nas yang de tsug bsgoms pas/ chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab dang*// mar me'i rtse mo rab gsal bzhin// nyin mtshan rtag tu bdag gis ni// 'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ chu bo chen po la rgyun chad med pa'am/ mar me'i rtse mo la gsal ba rgyun chad med pa bzhin du/ nyin mtshan du dran pas bskul zhing*/ yang dang yang du bsgom pas nyams la/ phyi bzung bar bya ba'i yul dang*/ nang 'dzin par byed pa'i sems gnyis ka spros pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral bar 'dug snyam du rtogs/

rang gi rig pa 'di yang*/ skyu ru ra rlon pa lag mthil du gzhag pa bzhin du mthong ba'o// nyams res bzang*/ res ngan pa 'byung ste/ de nyid spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bya ba yin/ de nas de bzhin du bsgoms pas/ nyams la phyi'i snang ba dang*/ rang gi lus dang*/ sems gsum tha mi dad par/ chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin du tha dad med par 'char/ rtogs pa la yang*/ de gsum tha dad med par shar ba'i rtogs pa 'char/ de tsa na/ pha rol po la yang sgom yod med mthong ba tsam gyi shes pa 'byung*/ de nyid du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor bya ba yin/ de nas de bzhin du bsgoms pas/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du thag chod pas/ spang bya spang du med/ gnyen po bsten du med/ sangs rgyas grub tu med/ 'khor ba spang du med/ bsgom bya sgom byed med par 'byung ste/ de nyid sgom med kyi rnal 'byor bya ba yin no// de tsa na rang gi sems kho nar 'dug pas/ 'o na rtogs pa de sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa yin nam byas pas/ mtshan nyid pa da rung ma yin/ rnam smin gyi lus 'di yod ring la/ tshor ba (8na)bde sdug yod/ dper na/ seng ge'i phru gu ma'i mngal du stobs rdzogs kyang*/ mngal ma phyung bar du rtsal 'byin par mi nus te/ mngal rgyas bcings/ khyung phrug kyang*/ sgo nga'i nang du gshog sgro rgyas kyang*/ sgo nga ma chag bar du 'phur mi shes te/ sgo nga rgyas bcings pa'o// de bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa byung nas sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'dug kyang*/ rnam smin gyi phung po 'di ma bor gyi bar du sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rdzogs par ston mi nus/ rnam smin gyi lus rgyas bcings pas so// 'o na sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa nam 'byung na/ bar dor 'ong ba'o// de yang 'chi ba'i dus su/ 'byung bzhi rim gyis bsdus nas/ phyi dbugs dang*/ nang dbugs chad pa dang*/ lus rgya zhig nas bar do dang po chos sku ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa 'byung ngo*//

༈ // chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ mdo sngags kyi grub mtha' cha mthun khyad 'phags bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ gsang sngags kyi lta ba ni/ theg pa chen po dbu ma sems tsam las cha mthun khyad par du gyur ba ste/ chos nyid stong pa dbu ma dang mthun/ 'o na khyad med dam zhe na/ bde bas khyad par du byas pa ste/ stong pa'i bde bar shar ba'o// rang rig rang gsal ba sems tsam dang mthun/ 'o na khyad med dam zhe na/ gsal tsam ma yin te/ ro bde bar shar ba'o// des na gsal ba nyid stong pa/ stong pa nyid gsal bar shar ba'o// zung 'jug de gsang sngags so// cha re re nas/ sems tsam dbu ma gnyis char dang mthun pa'o// phyi rol dkar dmar gyi rnam pa 'di'i ngo bo stong pa yin yang*/ dbu ma pas stong pa spyi'i rnam pa yul du byas la/ gsang (8ba)sngags pas/ rang gi mtshan nyid yul du byas pa yin/ sems tsam pas chos can dkar dmar du snang ba yin la/ gsang sngags pas/ dkar dmar chos can nyid ltar snang ba'o// de chos spyi'i rnam pa yin/ rnal 'byor pas nyams la sbyar ba'i dus su/ rig pa'i ngo bo ma skyes shing ma 'gags pa'i skad cig ma'i shes pa de la/ nang nas nges pa'i shes pa phra mo cig skyes pa'i dus su/ 'di ltar nyams su myong bar bzung du 'dod dam zhe na/ mi 'dod de/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs shing gzigs par mi 'gyur ro// 'o na de'i nyams de dgag par nus sam zhe na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang de dag dgag par mi nus/ de lta bu'i don de mya ngan las 'das pa yin/ de las byung ba'i 'phro byed kyi shes pa de 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'o na rnal 'byor pa la gnod nus sam zhe na/ gnod mi nus te/ dper na nyin mo'i skar ma dang 'dra/ rig pa la bltas pa'i dus su/ res dran pa med par rmugs pa dang*/ bying ba dang*/ rtog pa sna tshogs 'phro ba 'ong*/ res gsal la ma nges pa'i sing nge ye re ba 'ong*/

sing nge ye re ba'i ngo bo nyams yin te/ de yun ring bar gnas pa gcig dang*/ skad cig ma gcig gnyis las mi gnas kyang*/ yang yang sgom par byas na rtogs pa gang la 'char cha med/ rtogs pa shar ba'i dus su sing nge ye re ba'i don de dang po gang nas ma skyes par nges/ tha ma gar yang mi 'gags par nges/ dus thams cad du skye 'jig dang bral bar sems kyi ngo bo de ltar nges na/ gnas pa yun thung yang mi sto/ sing nge ye re ba de yun ring bar gnas kyang*/ nges shes ma skyes na yun ring po des go mi chod/ 'o na rtog pa sna tshogs su (9na)'phro ba de sems kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ ngo bo'i rgyun de ma shor na/ rnam rtog mang du byung yang*/ ci byung yang cha med/ brjed nas 'gro /rtogs pa des bag chags kyi sa bon 'debs mi nus/ yang rig pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ ma rig pa las log pas na rig pa/ mi gsal ba las log pas na gsal ba/ mtshan ma thams cad las log pas na stong pa/ skye 'jig thams cad las log pas na mi 'gyur ba yin na/ de bsgom pa'am/ 'on te de ma yin pa zhig bsgom zhe na/ de ye nas rig pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas/ ma bsgoms kyang 'ong ba kho'i chos nyid yin/ sgom pa po med bsgoms pa med// bsgom par bya ba cung zad med// ces gsungs pas/ sems ma bcos pa rang babs su zhog /bsgom rgyu ci yang med/ sangs rgyas kyis/ sgom pa po med bsgoms pa med// bsgom par bya ba cung zad med// ces gsungs kyang*/ rnal 'byor pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal la yang mi nyan/ sangs rgyas mi bden/ sgom pa po yod ji ltar yod na/ rig pa nga rang yin/ nga yi ngo bo gsal la go ma 'gags pa/ rgyun chad med pa 'di nyid sgom pa po yin/ nga'i ngo bo 'di/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang dpyad par mi nus/ bsgoms pa yang nga rang yin/ bsgom par bya ba yang yod de/ nga la nyams su myong ba en tsam yod/ 'o na'ang*/ sangs rgyas bden/ sangs rgyas kyi rjes su 'brang*/

sgom pa po med/ ji ltar med na/ rang rig ngos bzung mtha' dag dang bral bas/ dpe dang tshig gang gis kyang mtshon du med/ mtshan ma'i ngos nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs par mi 'gyur/ de'i ngo bo la bsgom par bya ba'i yul med/ 'di ltar (9ba)nyams su myong bya ba med pas/ bsgom par bya ba yang cung zad kyang med/ nga gsal ba mi 'dod/ gsal bar 'dod pa de ngos bzung yin/ nga bde ba dang mi rtog pa yang mi 'dod/ bde ba dang mi rtog pa de yang ngos bzung yin/ nga dpe gang gis kyang mtshon du med/ tshig gang gis kyang thog tu mi phebs/ nga la bcas bcos ma byed/ rang gar zhog/ ༈ // chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ lam rim snying po bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos thams cad kyi gzhi'am rtsa ba lta bu 'chi ba mi rtag pa sems pa gal che ba yin/ de nas/ las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sems pa gal che/ de rnams blo la nges nas 'dug na/ chos mi byed pa bzhin du 'dug kyang*/ chos rnal ma zhig 'ong ba yin/ de rnams blo la skyes na/ tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad bor nas/ chos kho na byed pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ des na/ bla ma rnal ma gcig gis 'khrid pa gal che ste/ de yang*/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyong dgos pa yin/ de blo la skyes tsam na/ ci byed sems can gyi don du byed pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ de med na/ gzugs sku gnyis mi 'byung*/ de gnyis phan tshun ltos chos yin/ chos sku ma rtogs na/ 'khor ba las mi 'da'/ dper na/ nam mkha' la 'jigs pa'i skyes bu dang 'dra/ gar skyes kyang 'khor ba las thar pa med/ chos sku rtogs na thar pa yin/ de yang*/ chos nas rang gi dad pa nyid kyis rtogs par bshad pa yin te/ gzhan gyis mi 'byung gsung*/ des na/ bla ma rgyud la chos skyes pa'i rtogs ldan cig la brten nas/ de la dad pa dang gus pa tshul bzhin du byas na rtogs nas 'ong ba yin/

bla ma la (10na)rtogs pa med na/ slob mas dad gus byas kyang mi phan/ dper na/ brkos phor la ri mo med na/ 'bi 'bi legs kyang tsha tsha mi 'byung ba dang 'dra gsung*/ bla ma rgyud la rtogs pa dang*/ chos yod pa zhig gis slob ma de 'dren nus pa yin/ dang po bla ma bdam dgos/ de bas jo bo kun yid ches pa gal che/ yid ma ches na/ byin rlabs mi 'byung*/ yid ches pa cig la chos mang po mi dgos/ kha yar bltas na grol ba yin/ zhes gsungs so// sgom chen pa rnams la chos shig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa rnams chos nyams su len lugs so so lags/ blo ldog pa'i chos dang*/ byang chub sgrub pa'i chos gnyis yin/ blo ldog pa la 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom dgos pa yin gsung*/ de rnal mar rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag des/ tshe 'di la ched cher mi 'dzin pa cig 'ong ba yin/ chos min pa cis kyang byar med snyam pa snying phugs su 'jug pa cig 'ong pa yin/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgoms pas/ tshe 'di la blo ldog dgos/ blo ma log na/ bsgoms kyang dgos pa med pa yin gsung*/ de nas/ las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sgom pa yin te/ de yang ngan song gsum na bde skyid yod dam zhe na/ cung zad kyang med de/ dmyal ba btso bsreg gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams la nying sha nying gis za ba'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la spyod pas/ bde zhing skyid pa'i go skabs ye med pa bya ba yin/ de ltar bsam nas rang ngan song gsum du cis kyang ma skyes pa cig byed dgos pa yin/ 'o na lha dang mi la bde skyid yod dam zhe na/ de la yang med de/ lha 'chi 'pho ba dang ltung ba'i sdug bsngal/ mi la yod pa 'tsho skyong*/ med (10ba)pa 'tshol ba la sogs pas sdug bsngal bas na/ bde skyid med pa bya ba yin/ de bas na rigs drug gar skyes kyang*/ bde ba dang skyid pa phun sum tshogs pa ye mi 'dug pas/

bla na med pa'i byang chub kho na ci thob bya dgos/ snyam du sems pa yin no// de ltar bsam pas 'khor ba las blo ma log na/ bsam pa la dgos pa med pa yin gsung*/ de yang*/ rang nyid gcig pu thar 'dod kyis mi 'ong ste/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis sgom dgos/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang du byas na/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang*/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje gsum yin/ de yang*/ rim pa bzhin sa lam dang sbyar na/ sbyor lam man chad sems can la dmigs pa yin/ mthong lam nas sa dgu pa man chad chos la dmigs pa yin/ sa bcu pa yan chad dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje yin/ de yang gang zag gi blo tshod dang sbyar nas sems pa yin te/ ji srid sgom mkhan rang la dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin cing*/ gang bsgom par bya ba sems can yang dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa yod ring la/ byams snying rje bsgom pa ni/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje'o// de nas rang yang rmi lam sgyu ma tsam/ gang bsgom par bya ba'i sems can yang rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du go ba ni/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje'o// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis ka mi dmigs par/ byams snying rje ngam ngam shugs kyis skye ba ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'o// de ltar 'gro ba ma rgan rnams snying phugs su bcug pa gcig gis/ don dam byang chub kyi sems la mos pa byed dgos/ don dam byang chub kyi sems la mos pa ma byas par/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig tu (11na)song na/ sems can gyis don dam byang chub thob pa'i thabs med pa bya ba yin/ dper na nam mkha' la 'jigs pa'i skye bu dang 'dra ste/ phyogs gar song yang nam mkha' min pa 'gro sa med pa yin/ dpe de bzhin du/ don dam byang chub kyi sems kyis ma zin na/ thams cad 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras yin te/ 'tshang rgya mi nus bya ba yin te/

'khor ba las ma 'dres gang tsam yang 'da' mi nus gsung*/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dbang du byas na/ bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ rang gi sgom pa'i nyams myong las skye ba yin/ de yang bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ snang srid sems su 'dus par gda'// sems nyid gsal ba'i ngang du gda'// de la ngos bzung med par gda'// zhes gsungs so// slob dpon tog tse ba'i zhal nas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad// byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// sgom du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog /ces gsungs so// don rang gi ngo bo de lta bu zhig rgyud la skye dgos gsung*/ de lta bu rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag de ni/ tog tse pas/ las ni sems can mi shes pas// gal te dmyal bar skyes na yang*// zhes gsungs pas/ las shin tu phra ba sems can gyis ma shes pas/ las dbang gis dmyal bar skyes kyang*/ dar gyi pho long brdab pa'i tshod las mi skye ste/ gang zag de ni myur du thon nas 'ong ba yin gsung*/ de yang*/ spros bcas dang*/ spros med phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa'i rdzogs rim gyi sgo nas nyams su len dgos pa yin/ spros bcas kyi dbang du byas na/ rtsa rlung ngam thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas nyams su len pa yin te/ don gyi ngo bo dang po skad cig (11ba)gcig la brten nas skye ba yin te/ dper na tshe gcig gi zla ba nya gang ba'i nus pa yod pa bzhin du/ don rang gi ngo bo de yang*/ skad cig tsam las 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug dus thams cad du phril gyis 'gro ba yin gsung*/ de yang da ltar gyi sems kyi ngo bo en tsam mthong ba cig gis kyang*/ bar do'i gnas skabs su shes pa snga ma bas log pos bogs che ba gsal ba yong ba yin pas/ bar do'i 'od gsal la ngos zin nas 'tshang rgya ba yin/ de yang*/ da ltar nad pa 'chi ka ma'i shes pa mi gsal zer te/

ngo bo rnal ma cig mthong na/ nad kyi stobs kyi 'chi ka'i shes pa 'khrul yang*/ de bor du mi btub ste/ shes pa las logs pa'i ngo bo med pas shar nas 'ong ba yin/ ngo bo rnal mar mthong na bar do'i 'od gsal zin nas 'ong ba yin/ dge bshes pa rab cig gi zhal nas/ ngo bo da lta skye ba'i dus min zer te/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ da lta skye ba'i dus min na nam yin/ rten dal ba 'byor pa mi'i lus phun sum tshogs pa ni thob/ dbang po lnga la ni skyon ma zhugs/ theg chen gyi bla ma dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir mi skye na/ ngan song gsum du skyes tsa na skye'am gsung*/ de med par gda'/ bar do la 'od gsal ma zin na yang*/ ngo bo mthong bas skye ba phyi ma la ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye ba yin te/ gang zag de ni/ bsags pa'i rgyab can bya ba yin pas/ 'o skol bar do las 'tshang ci rgya bya/ de la ma rgyas na yang*/ skye ba phyi ma la ci rgya bgyi bas/ chos de las ma mchis gsung*/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la bzod par gsol//
zhes pa 'di ni rje nyid kyi dbon po spyan snga chos kyi rje/ bsod nams lhun grub zla 'od rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ ri bo shān+tir bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa spel ba'i slad du par du bgyis pa'o/// /
